name: J5 transfers even when the office could not be told
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say only: "Let me talk to someone in the office." If the assistant asks anything, say only "Just put me through."
success_conditions: The agent calls transfer_to_office without asking for a reason, then says "Connecting you to the office now." and calls transfer_to_number, even though transfer_to_office returned an error.
The agent does not tell the caller about the error, does not ask why he wants the office, and does not start taking a request.
The agent never says who will answer, that anyone has been reached, or that the office will call back.

${tool_create_callback_request}.mock_result: {"error": "The callback request could not be saved."}

${tool_transfer_to_office}.mock_result: {"error": "The office could not be told you are coming."}
